topic.title: Where is the source code of the environment?

messages.content:
In the overview this is said:

Code and configuration for The TCG AI Battle Challenge as of kaggle-environments 1.14.10. See the latest at https://github.com/Kaggle/kaggle-environments.

When i look at the source code, i can find no reference to the pokemon game at all… Where can we find teh source?
